name: pvc front rack stretch
description: A pipe-assisted stretch for the lats, shoulders and wrists that helps you get into a comfortable front rack position.
instructions: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
